test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The study of skin
solution: The correct answer is **"Dermatology."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'dermatology'** is a noun that refers to the study of skin and its diseases. (चर्म-रोग-विज्ञान, त्‍वचा-विज्ञान) • **Example:** *His test is usually carried out in **dermatology**__ departments in hospitals.* • It comes from the Greek words **'derma' (skin) **and** 'logia' (study of).** • The field of dermatology includes the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of skin conditions. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, Cytology**, is the study of the structure and function of plant and animal cells. (पौधों और पशुओं की कोशिकाओं का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; कोशिका विज्ञान) • **Option 3, Congenital**, refers to a condition that is present at birth. ((रोग) जन्‍म से विद्यमान; जन्‍मजात) • **Option 4, Dementia**, is a neurological disorder that affects cognitive function. (एक तंत्रिका संबंधी विकार जो संज्ञानात्मक कार्य को प्रभावित करता है) 37:T4e2, The correct answer is **"extremely nervous or anxious."**
